import numpy as np

def ode(Y, t, params, cell_positions):
    p = params
    
    # 開局全白
    if t < 0.001 and not p.get('is_initialized', False):
        Y[:, 0] = np.pi  
        p['is_initialized'] = True
        
    dY = np.zeros_like(Y)
    theta = Y[:, 0]
    state = Y[:, 1] if Y.shape[1] > 1 else np.zeros_like(theta)
    
    # 假設 get_voronoi_neighbors_wo_outer 已定義
    neighbors = get_voronoi_neighbors_wo_outer(cell_positions)
    x_positions = cell_positions[:, 0]
    max_x, min_x = np.max(x_positions), np.min(x_positions)
    x_norm = (x_positions - min_x) / (max_x - min_x + 1e-8)
    
    # ⏳ 波前延遲 (8.0 單位)
    front_delay = p.get('front_delay', 8.0)
    if t < front_delay:
        current_front = p.get('start_front', 0.0) 
    else:
        current_front = p.get('start_front', 0.0) + p.get('front_speed', 0.032) * (t - front_delay)
        
    # 確保 current_front 不超過 1.0 (Numba 友善的寫法)
    if current_front > 1.0:
        current_front = 1.0
        
    # === 🧪 物理環境與藥物狀態 ===
    if 14.0 <= t <= 26.0:
        is_drug_active = True
        global_K = 0.0       # 加藥時失去通訊
        global_noise = 1.0   
    else:
        is_drug_active = False
        global_K = p.get('K_coupling', 1.5) # 洗藥後立刻恢復通訊
        global_noise = 0.1   
        
    for i in range(Y.shape[0]):
        distance_from_front = x_norm[i] - current_front
        
        # === 🎨 記憶晶片與命運判定 ===
        if x_norm[i] < current_front:
            # 【結凍區】
            dY[i, 0] = 0.0  
            if state[i] < 0.5: # 剛被黃線掃到、還沒永久結凍的細胞
                # 結凍的瞬間，看當下有沒有藥！有藥就鎖定成綠色(2.0)，沒藥就鎖定成紅色(1.0)
                if is_drug_active:
                    target_frozen_state = 2.0  
                else:
                    target_frozen_state = 1.0  
                dY[i, 1] = (target_frozen_state - state[i]) / p.get('dT', 1/20.0)
            else:
                dY[i, 1] = 0.0 # 已經固定的，永遠維持不變！
            continue
            
        else:
            # 【未結凍 PSM 區】
            if is_drug_active:
                target_state = -1.0 # 有藥：全體立刻變綠
            else:
                target_state = 0.0  # 洗藥：全體立刻變回紅
                
            dY[i, 1] = (target_state - state[i]) / p.get('dT', 1/20.0)
        
        # === 🧬 物理計算 (改成 Numba-Safe 的寫法) ===
        neibs = neighbors[i]
        coupling_effect = 0.0
        
        if neibs:
            sum_w = 0.0
            sum_coupling = 0.0
            for j, w in neibs.items():
                # 計算相位差的 sin 值並乘上權重
                sum_coupling += w * np.sin(theta[j] - theta[i])
                sum_w += w
                
            if sum_w > 0:
                coupling_effect = sum_coupling / sum_w
            
        omega_i = p['omega_min'] + (p['omega_max'] - p['omega_min']) * distance_from_front
        
        noise = np.random.normal(0, global_noise)
        dY[i, 0] = omega_i + global_K * coupling_effect + noise

    # 每隔一段時間印出狀態 (Numba 在 fallback 模式下支援 print)
    if int(t * 100) % 100 == 0:  
        print("Time:", t, "| Global K:", global_K, "| Drug:", is_drug_active, "| Front:", current_front)
    
    Y_new = Y + dY * p.get('dT', 1/20.0)
    dY = (Y_new - Y) / p.get('dT', 1/20.0)
    
    return dY
